calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) as contacted_members
FROM fact_campaign_exposure
WHERE campaign_id = 19

SELECT 
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as total_spending
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
WHERE fsl.member_key IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_key
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure
  WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'

WITH contacted_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_key
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure
  WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.member_key) as members_contacted,
  COALESCE(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 0) as spending_eur
FROM contacted_members cm
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl 
  ON fsl.member_key = cm.member_key
  AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
